variants.prompt: REFORM OUTFIT/ATTIRE: Adorned in sheer black lingerie, the adventurous beauty lounges seductively on the yacht's deck, the moonlight casting a silver sheen on her porcelain skin. Delicate lace edges the cups of her demi-bra, while a matching thong leaves little to the imagination. A delicate silver chain around her neck and a pair of chandelier earrings add a touch of sophisticated glamour to her provocative ensemble.
